title: Made Some big updates, so I thought I'd do a better post
author: dank_nuggins
selftext:
Hello! This is a project that I have been working on solo for basically a year now, its an idea I had as a kid when I was watching my brother play warhammer while I played final fantasy tactics on gameboy color. I wanted warhammer on my gameboy! Over the years I've been a dungeon master and artist, but not a very good artist, and through it all this game idea has stuck with me. When I started development, I was never able to get very far due to my inexperience and lack of education. I tried to work around this by learning codeless game engines like Gdevelop, and tried my hand at Blueprints, but I just couldn't get it to make sense. Then I saw a video of AI making a game, and I thought, surely, it has to be complete garbage, ala will smith eating spaghetti type stuff, but the more I looked the more potential I saw for it to bridge the gaps in my knowledge and expertise to deliver an idea.

So that's what I did, I took my idea, and let AI do the coding stuff that I couldn't wrap my head around, and it works, and its a good approximation of what I wanted. Now though I want to bring actual people in on the project. I've already started hiring voice actors and I want to bring artists and composers in on the project. The idea is to make concrete this vision of mine before launching it on steam. I'm currently going through the approval process for steam, and will have online matches through your friends list available shortly after approval for playtesting purposes, I also plan on random matchmaking in the future.

Would love some feedback, if you want links to support the project let me know! I'm doing this all out of pocket so far, and I live on disability (back injury and stuff), so its not exactly easy. Thanks for reading! 

PS had no idea what flair this falls under or if it violates rule 3 at all, tried to make it respectful!
